verdict.rationale: Asking whether an immigration law firm offers structured document collection (client portal, checklists, uploads, reminders) is a fair question, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence describes such a workflow. The pack covers only visa service offerings, attorney supervision, responsiveness and firm background, none of which documents checklists, upload portals or automated reminders.

support.subject: As a legal-ops lead, evidence and document collection runs through a structured workflow (checklists, uploads, reminders) rather than email attachments
